title: Spotify for Artists Playlist Lift Persistence
dataSources: Release events (`music:distribution`), Bandcamp activity (`music:bandcamp`), project exports (`music:project`), streaming analytics (`music:streaming`), metadata tasks (`music:ops`).
app: Music-making and creator telemetry — DistroKid release exports, Bandcamp sales activity, Cockos Reaper project stats, and Spotify for Artists analytics — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=music:streaming playlist_name=* stream_lift_pct=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats avg(stream_lift_pct) as metric by _time playlist_name
| sort 0 _time playlist_name
description: Trends monthly playlist lift percentage by playlist for playlist placement effects.
value: Monthly trend lines show whether playlist placement effects are improving, stalling, or becoming unbalanced over time.
implementation: Normalize `playlist_name` on `music:streaming` events and store the fields needed to calculate monthly playlist lift percentage.
visualization: Line chart of monthly playlist lift percentage by playlist.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals how playlist lift percentage changes month by month for each playlist so you can see whether playlist placement effects are heading the right way.
